Product.title: Product
Product.description: An electronics or retail product sold at El-Mahallawy Store.

id.description: Unique product identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

shortDescription.description: Concise summary shown on product cards.

description.description: Full detailed description shown in the product details view.

price.description: Current selling price in Egyptian Pounds (EGP).

originalPrice.description: Original price before discount in Egyptian Pounds (EGP).

discountEnabled.description: Whether promotional discount pricing is active.

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently available in stock.

isFeatured.description: Whether the product is highlighted as a selected item.

isPublished.description: Whether the product is publicly visible on the storefront.

images.description: Bounded list (1..8) of public product image URLs.

options.description: Bounded list (0..10) of selectable product variants or colors.

authorUid.description: UID of the administrator who created the product.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the super-admin who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/products/{productId}.description: Storefront product catalog managed by administrators and publicly readable when published.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted admin lookup documents restricted strictly to administrators.
